title: Construction of Ramps at Main Entrances of Selected HDB flats
what_it_is: Construction of Ramps at Main Entrances of Selected HDB flats

sections.label: Ramp solutions for flats
sections.summary: For flats with more than a one-step difference, building a standard ramp faces technical, space and configuration challenges, so flat owners choose from commercially available options with HDB, agency and VWO help.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For flats with more than a one-step difference, there are technical, space as well as configuration challenges to building a standard ramp.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: These challenges are not insurmountable, but they require customised solutions to fit the various flat configurations and resident needs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: And this is why our approach is to let flat owners identify and choose their preferred solutions from among the wide range of commercially available options in the market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: What HDB does then is to work with the relevant agencies and the Voluntary Welfare Organisations (VWOs) to assist those who need help in implementing these solutions.
